title: Recap: discovery outcomes & propose final 30-min preview
text:
Recap: discovery outcomes & propose final 30-min preview

['From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@cloudnine.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Recap + 3 windows to lock a 30-min preview

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: CloudNine is evaluating ways to reduce per-query cost for large-scale embeddings and to add deterministic, lower-latency inference for search ranking across your pipelines. You and Mark highlighted the need for predictable throughput, on-prem options for sensitive datasets, and a straightforward rollout path for integration with your ingestion pipeline.

Suggested next step: a focused 30-minute product preview (high-level demo + brief infra/embedding Q&A) with your engineering lead and whoever will own deployment. I have three slots available — please pick what works best:

- Tue, Aug 29 — 10:00 AM ET (30 min)
- Wed, Aug 30 — 2:00 PM ET (30 min)
- Thu, Aug 31 — 11:00 AM ET (30 min)

If none of those fit, tell me 2 windows that do and I’ll re-propose. For the meeting, could you confirm:
- attendees (engineer/infra/security)
- main success criteria for the preview (e.g., latency targets, on-prem feasibility, integration effort)

I’ve attached the discovery notes and a short runbook I’ll use during the preview.

Attachments: RDW-Discovery-Notes-CloudNine.pdf (summary), Redwood-Preview-Runbook.docx (agenda + demo checklist)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

', 'From: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@cloudnine.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri yom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Dobson <mark.dobson@cloudnine.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + 3 windows to lock a 30-min preview

Thanks, Priyom — great recap and the notes look helpful.

A couple quick items from our side: Mark (CC’d) will want to join; our engineering lead is likely Sarah Lopez (I’ll confirm). We have a standing leadership review on Thursday mornings, which makes Thu less reliable for us.

Tue, Aug 29 at 10:00 AM ET looks promising — can you hold that as a tentative? If you need final confirmation from Mark, I can confirm by end of day. Also, two quick pre-demo asks from our security/compliance team:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports geo-fenced model serving or guarantees for EU data residency?
- Is there a short data-flow diagram you can share prior to the preview?

If you can call out those points on the agenda, that would help surface the right folks on our side.

Alyssa
Director, Platform Partnerships | CloudNine Analytics
alyssa.green@cloudnine.com | +1 650-555-0123

Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 16:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + 3 windows to lock a 30-min preview

Alyssa — great, I’ll tentatively hold Tue, Aug 29 at 10:00 AM ET and send a calendar invite. Agenda will be concise: 1) 10–12 minute product preview focused on embeddings & low-latency serving; 2) 10-minute infra Q&A (throughput, residency, on-prem options); 3) 5-minute next steps / MAP.

I’ll call out EU geo-fencing and include a simple data-flow slide up front. Attaching the runbook again for visibility.

Proposed invite (will send once you confirm):
Title: CloudNine — 30m product preview (Redwood Inference)
When: Tue, Aug 29 2027 10:00 AM ET (30 min)
Location: Google Meet (link below)

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/rwd-cloudnine-preview
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4721

Can you confirm Sarah Lopez (engineering) or the appropriate tech contact? If Mark wants a dedicated security engineer on the call, we can pull in our security solutions lead — Ben, can you join if we need to handle the compliance/geo question?

—
Priyom

Mark
